sloka: अन्तरा पण्यवीथ्यश्च सर्वे च नटनर्तकाः ।सूदा नार्यश्च बहवो नित्यं यौवनशालिनः ।। ७.९१.२२ ॥
transliteration: antarā paṇyavīthyaśca sarve ca naṭanartakāḥ ।sūdā nāryaśca bahavo nityaṁ yauvanaśālinaḥ ।। 7.91.22 ॥

translations.english: Along the way, there should be market streets, and all actors and dancers, as well as many cooks and perpetually youthful women.
